property_summary: For any caller and any wei amount, calling addToBalance increases the contract's stored balance for that caller by exactly msg.value (i.e., post-call userBalance(caller) == pre-call userBalance(caller) + amount); the mutant that zeroes the balance breaks this (some inputs show no net increase).
change_summary: Set the caller's balance to zero after adding msg.value, so the net stored balance remains unchanged (affects observable balances at keys).
